summary: Completed the browser and session security review. The web server now emits baseline security headers and an origin-scoped CSP for HTML responses, while the browser matrix verifies cache privacy, token non-persistence, hostile redirect rejection, protected-route denial, locale/direction behavior, and absence of sensitive values in rendered pages. Existing in-memory access-token storage, refresh deduplication, logout clearing, and API cookie security were verified by focused Web and API tests.
